messages:
Oliver (CEO): Quick weekly exec note — high level priorities for the next 7 days. TL;DR: stabilize EU private beta, hit reliability SLOs, and accelerate cost reduction experiments. Short asks below.

Oliver (CEO): 1) Private EU beta: ship final onboarding flow + compliance checklist. goal: sign first 3 pilot customers this quarter.
Oliver (CEO): 2) Reliability: p99 inference latency target = 150ms across hosted tiers; current p99 ~220ms on peak. We need mitigation plan and canary schedule.
Oliver (CEO): 3) Cost/capex: unit cost target -10% MoM via batching/quantization and smarter routing. Finance needs runway impact.
Oliver (CEO): 4) Hiring: prioritize SRE (2 ICs) + infra (1 SWEng) for next sprint.
Oliver (CEO): Quick asks: can teams confirm owners and rough ETA by EOD Tues? cc @Sophia @Ravi @Maya @Jen

Sophia (VP Product): Acked. Will own EU beta launch checklist and pilot outreach. Meeting with privacy/legal Wed 9am.
Sophia (VP Product): Question: do we want canary traffic split 5/20/50 or start smaller?

Ravi (VP Eng): 5/20/50 sounds fine for Canary -> Ramp if no regressions. I want a short rollback playbook and automated health checks.
Ravi (VP Eng): On latency: infra has a draft micro-optimizations list (kernel tweaks, kv cache TTLs, batching heuristic). I'll share by EOD.

Maya (Head of Ops): Noted. Ops will run the EU preflight in staging tomorrow 6pm UTC. I'll attach the test matrix after the run.
Maya (Head of Ops): Also flag: two related incidents last week (token cache thrash + NFS latency) contributed ~30% of spikes. We're putting guards in.

Jen (Finance): Cost ask noted. Can you quantify the "-10%" into $/token or monthly run-rate? I need numbers for the board deck by Friday.

Oliver (CEO): Jen: rough target = reduce unit inference cost from ~$0.0032/token to ~$0.0029/token (back-of-envelope). Happy to refine once Ravi shares optimizations.

Marco (PM): For pilot customers, suggest we prepare an FAQ + known-limits doc. I'll start a short doc and post in #customer-success.

Ravi (VP Eng): deploy-bot will run the canary tonight 11pm PT. Adding health checks: 2xx rate, p50/p95/p99, error-rate delta <= 0.2%. Rollback threshold = 0.5% error delta.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: service:redwood-inference eu-private-v2 -> instances: 4 -> canary-split:5%

Maya (Head of Ops): Running synthetic traffic now. Early signal: p95 holding, p99 still ~210ms on synthetic with large-context jobs. Investigating kv cache miss patterns.

Sophia (VP Product): Thanks — please call out any UX-limiting regressions so we can decide on rollout pause.

Ravi (VP Eng): Noted. If p99 > 180ms after 20 minutes of canary, we pause and rollback.

Oliver (CEO): Great. Two final asks:
1) Each owner add their ETA to this thread by EOD Tue.
2) Small comms: product should prepare a 1-paragraph customer-facing blurb for the pilot (Marco -> draft).

Marco (PM): Will post draft by tomorrow noon PT.

Jen (Finance): I'll model the -10% as a sensitivity case and circulate an updated burn and runway slide by Thu.

Maya (Head of Ops): Test matrix and early run results will be in #eng-sre after the synthetic completes (ETA 11:20pm PT).

Ravi (VP Eng): Optimization list sent to the channel (link). Starting work on kv cache TTL & batching heuristics now.

Oliver (CEO): Thanks team. Small wins matter — focus on measurable targets this week. :rocket:

Sophia (VP Product): :thumbsup:

Ravi (VP Eng): :thumbsup:
